snippet.title: PlayStation - Dragon Beat - Legend of Pinball (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
A revolutionary new pinball game has arrived! Dragon Beat Legend of Pinball provides players with the ultimate pinball experience rolled into two different game modes to suite the palettes of all potential pinball wizards!

The unique "Dragon Mode" features a pinball machine-themed stage design where you defeat the ultimate dragon to save the princess!

The "Simple Mode" is a bit more conventional, and it features a nudging technique feature, simulating a real pinball machine!
